title: Meta: Fix prototype lookup, regex defects, canvas stroke, and worker bugs
body: ### Description This is an editorial and infrastructure maintenance pull request addressing several bugs and security considerations across specification helper scripts, styles, and demos: - **`html-dfn.js`**: Grouped `storage` inside the regex alternation and removed the trailing empty pipe (`|/`), which previously matched empty strings and prepended empty `` tags before every reference title. - **`link-fixup.js`**: Guarded `fragid` fragment lookup using `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty` to avoid prototype property matches (e.g., `#toString`), safely decoded the hash inside a `try...catch` to avoid uncaught `URIError` on malformed percent encoding, and replaced deprecated `substr()` with `slice()`. - **`dev/search.js`**: Replaced dynamic regex creation with safe case-insensitive substring search to prevent uncaught `SyntaxError` crashes when users type regex characters (`(`, `[`, `*`, etc.); added HTML entity escaping and URL encoding to avoid injection; updated keyboard navigation to traverse element siblings instead of whitespace text nodes; and guarded the `/` search shortcut from stealing focus while typing in inputs. - **`styles.css`**: Corrected selector typo from `#table-import-map-scopes-example th[row="3"]`, which never matched, to `th[rowspan="3"]`, restoring the intended `writing-mode: vertical-rl` on the Referrer table header. - **`demos/workers/crypto/libcrypto-v2.js`**: Renamed duplicate `function encrypt(p)` definition to `function decrypt(p)` so the decryptor worker can be reached and doesn't overwrite encrypt. - **`demos/canvas/blue-robot/*.html`**: Replaced non-standard `context.lineStyle` with standard `context.strokeStyle`. - **`demos/workers/multiviewer/worker.js`**: Corrected inverted row/column coordinate boundaries in `sendMapData` and `wrapY`, and guarded `viewers` lookup against prototype keys. - **`var-click-highlighting.js`**: Added null safety to the DOM traversal loop to prevent `Cannot read properties of null` errors. - **`source`**: Added contributor to the Acknowledgments list lexicographically. This is a Meta/editorial maintenance PR (no normative spec changes). *** /acknowledgements.html ( diff )
